items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Him and Jimmy Harrison, they were the two, trombone and trumpet... They were in Charlie Johnson's band

ctx.x: So you know, if he was playing something in the first register, that to people is way out. That don't mean nothin' to these people. So when you're playing in the first position, like Jimmy Harrison or Higgenbotham playing up there, using all different (?).
